in_marathi.name: Sopan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sopan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sopan signifies a path, a way, a journey. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sopana' which means a ladder, a staircase, or a step-by-step progression. The name is often given to a child who is expected to grow up to be wise, understanding, and compassionate.
